component.name: Typio Settings
component.summary: Configure the Typio input method framework

description.p: Typio Settings is the graphical configuration application for Typio. It uses the daemon's TIP control interface for schema-backed settings and preserves the Panel's platform configuration when updating display preferences.

ul.li: Choose the active language, keyboard engine, and voice engine.
Edit engine options exposed by the active schema.
Configure shortcuts, notifications, and advanced behavior.
Tune candidate layout, typography, theme, and placement.

description.p: Initial Rust settings application using the Iris/Lens/Flux graphics stack and the shared Typio TIP client.
